about: Every setting in Olymparch, in one list. The Settings window draws its pages from it, olymparch-settings validates and applies from it, and tests/settings-coverage fails if anything configurable is missing. apply.via: shell = read live by the shell from settings.json; hypr = written to hypr.lua and applied with hyprctl eval; monitor = monitors.lua + hyprctl eval; idle = hypridle.conf + restart; audio = wpctl; cursor = hl.env + hyprctl setcursor; bluetooth = bluetoothctl power; power = powerprofilesctl; mime = ~/.config/mimeapps.list; terminal = OLYMPARCH_TERMINAL in hypr.lua; unit = systemctl --user mask/unmask; dropin = Environment= in a user unit drop-in; headset = pipewire-pulse drop-in + pactl; mangohud = ~/.config/olymparch/MangoHud.conf; envd = ~/.config/environment.d; brightness = brightnessctl; system = /etc through pkexec /usr/lib/olymparch/settings-apply (fixed actions); stored = kept in settings.json for the tool that uses it; action = runs a command; info = shown, not set. ready=false entries are shown as «coming». needs = a program the setting needs; without it the window hides the row. widget items = a list (olymparch-settings items/pick).
